$comment: zen-agent configuration. Copy to zen.json next to your vault (or ~/.zen/zen.json). Paths are relative to the vault. Secrets are never here: name the environment variable that holds them. The model is the cheap default for bot wakes (OPENROUTER_API_KEY); openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash is the alternative, and a persona's model field or --model overrides it per run.

context.$fetchers_example: context fetchers per card work type, team or default, e.g. { "default": ["recall"], "coding": ["tracker", "github"], "team:research": ["recall"] }; names: tracker (cli-projects list rows for the card's project), github (gh pr view / run list for the card's branch), recall (cli-org recall for the card's title). All off by default; a wake is always a fresh session

$machines_example: Connected computers running Ollama, name -> { url, contextWindow? }, e.g. { "box": { "url": "http://192.0.2.10:11434", "contextWindow": 32000 } }. Their installed models are discovered live and offered as ollama-box/<tag>. Or set OLLAMA_MACHINES=box=http://192.0.2.10:11434. contextWindow = that server's OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH.
